about: The cover step's styles (thumbs_up.py). Each native style is set from a breakdown of real covers on that platform's discovery surface, pulled and indexed as swipes (components/asset-index/swipes/covers.py; rows in runs/asset-index/swipes/covers/covers.json, sums in patterns.json). 'evidence' quotes those sums. Change a style through a new pull and its numbers, not by taste.

instagram.label: Instagram native (caption on a box)
evidence: 67 Instagram Explore covers (US, Canada, UK locales), median 163k likes, median 2.8 days old.
Look: native 51%, lightly edited 21%, raw 18%; designed 6%, studio 4%.
Words on 72% (text read); median 7 words read by eye. Caption line height on the 40 native-caption covers: smallest quarter 3.0%, median 3.6%, top tenth 4.9%, largest 10.5% of the cover height.
Text treatment: plain native caption 28%, caption on a box 19%, outlined caption 13%, designed type 6%, none 31%.
Case: sentence 36%, lower 13%, upper 10%. Placement: top 24%, middle 21%, lower-middle 18%.
Marks: emoji 13%, logo 10%, sticker 4%, circle 1%, arrow 1%, price 1%, stamp 0%. Grade: as shot 67%.
Colour: median saturation 0.30 and colourfulness 38 (YouTube 0.44 and 65).
Size set to the top of that range (100 px type, about 5% of the height, bold) after the owner, 11 Nov, on the first set at 60 px (3%): 'we can barely see the text'.

instagram-plain.label: Instagram native (plain caption)
evidence: Same 67 covers: the plain white native caption (no box) is the most used text treatment, 28%. Reads only over a darker part of the frame.

tiktok.label: TikTok native
evidence: 47 TikTok Explore and For You covers (US), each 500k+ views in its first 14 days, median 1.49M views, median 3.3 days old.
No words on 57%. Where there are words: plain native caption 19%, outlined 11%, box 2%.
Placement: middle 21%, spread 9%, lower-middle 6%, top 6%. Text line 5.5% of the height.
Look: native 40%, raw 30%, studio 21%. Marks: logo 13%, emoji 9%, no circles, arrows or stamps.
Frame: scene 30%, face 21%, body 15%; 38% show no person.

youtube-shorts.label: YouTube Shorts native
evidence: 11 YouTube Shorts (most viewed in the last 14 days, 250k+ views; YouTube has no public Shorts explore feed). Small sample.
Text: outlined 27%, designed 18%, box 18%, none 36%. Placement: top 27%, middle 27%. Look: native 45%, raw 36%.

youtube.label: YouTube long-form
evidence: 42 YouTube Trending covers (US), 100k+ views, median 307k views, median 1.3 days old.
Look: studio 55%, designed 43%. Grade saturated 57%; median saturation 0.44, colourfulness 65.
Text: designed type 40%, title card 24%, none 33%; upper case 48%; median 2 words; text line 11.7% of the height.
Placement: top 26%, bottom 19%, middle 17%. Faces: shock 24% of covers. Split or collage 31%.
Marks: logo 45%, border 14%, number 12%, arrow 5%, circle 2%.

turned-up.label: Turned up (the original look)
evidence: Owner, 10 Nov: clickbait/watchbait, every element turned up. Not built from a pull; closest to YouTube long-form (designed 43%, saturated 57%).
